name: @mercatus-liber/recommendations
description: Admin-curated, explicit product-to-product recommendations ("Customers also bought") for the PDP and cart page (subsystem 18). Depends on @mercatus-liber/core only -- never imports @mercatus-liber/cart, @mercatus-liber/checkout-orders, @mercatus-liber/promotions, @mercatus-liber/bundles, @mercatus-liber/inventory, @mercatus-liber/catalog, or @mercatus-liber/analytics. Deliberately thinner than promotions/bundles: it never validates product ids against catalog at write time -- product ids are stored as bare strings and resolved by the app-composition layer at render time.
